# ECN-2026-040 Change notice - Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P1, line P1-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L1-RR01

Reason for change
- During production qualification for expanded product capability, the usable maximum ring outer diameter for EQ-P1-L1-RR01 has been confirmed as 1240 mm. This formalizes the machine limit for planning, tooling selection, and part routing.
- The change corrects legacy documentation that omitted a single-source maximum dimension and aligns maintenance, setup, and production procedures with measured capability. See MM-P1-L1-RR01 for maintenance implications and SOP-P1-L1-01 and SOP-P1-L1-05 for operational and setup procedure alignment.

Affected items
- Process routing and work instructions that reference ring maximum outer diameter for EQ-P1-L1-RR01.
- Production planning lists and ERP routing entries that control job assignments to P1-L1 line using EQ-P1-L1-RR01.
- Tooling qualification records and die selection guidance tied to the equipment envelope.
- Maintenance checklists that verify machine travel and guarding clearances; update reference MM-P1-L1-RR01.

Implementation
- Update all process documents and work instructions to state the maximum ring outer diameter limit for EQ-P1-L1-RR01 as 1240 mm. Reference MM-P1-L1-RR01 during maintenance actions and follow SOP-P1-L1-01 and SOP-P1-L1-05 for setup and operation procedures.
- Production planners shall apply the updated limit to job routing and tooling assignment. Tooling owners must re-qualify dies and fixtures against the confirmed envelope and document compliance in tooling records.
- Maintenance shall verify guarding and sensor positions to ensure safe operation within the stated maximum and record findings per MM-P1-L1-RR01.
- Quality shall perform first-article verification for any part families impacted by the revised limit and reference SOP-P1-L1-01 for inspection criteria.

Approvals
- Engineering authorization required prior to document release.  
- Production planning, Maintenance, and Quality sign-off required for implementation.  
Related documents: MM-P1-L1-RR01, SOP-P1-L1-01, SOP-P1-L1-05
